India-Israel Bilateral Investment Agreement Enters Into Force

The India-Israel Bilateral Investment Agreement (BIA) has officially come into force. The agreement aims to strengthen investment protection and enhance the economic partnership between the two nations. It is expected to boost cross-border investment and trade. This development follows the agreement's signing and ratification processes.
